spark.byteSummary:
**Core Mechanics:** Modern Java (17–25) brings **Data-Oriented Programming** via three interlocking features: **`record`**: shallowly immutable data carriers with auto-generated constructor, accessors, `equals`, `hashCode`, and `toString`.

explanation.foundation: Legacy Java DTOs cram optional fields into one mutable class, forcing `null` checks everywhere, while `default: throw new IllegalStateException()` in switches hides missing cases until runtime.
